text:
Maya Chen: FYI dedicated-usw2-reserved pool is saturating, seeing sustained queueing and a bunch of 429s for reserved customers (corp-a, corp-b). Latency P95 jumped to 1.2s for text-gen requests.
Julian Park: copying graphs — queue_length and inflight per-GPU? any autoscale activity?
Maya Chen: autoscaler tried a scale up but failed to allocate GPUs in us-west-2 zone A due to AZ capacity errors. Admission control started rejecting low-priority reserved jobs at 15:12 UTC.
oncall-bot: [alert] dedicated-pool-usw2: capacity_pressure HIGH -> admission_control=ENABLED (rule: reserved_throttle_high) at 2025-11-08T15:12:03Z
Sophie Alvarez: do we have a recent change to batching or session affinity that could increase per-request GPU utilization?
Maya Chen: no config change in the last 24h. Traffic spike from corp-a after their internal rollout + corp-b scheduled batch jobs.
Leo Gupta: I pulled metrics: pool utilization 98%, queue_depth ~380, avg_batch_size up 18%. Here's the influx query I ran:
```
from(bucket: "redwood-metrics")
|> range(start: -2h)
|> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gpu_pool")
|> filter(fn: (r) => r.pool == "dedicated-usw2-reserved")
|> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
|> keep(columns:["_time","utilization","queue_depth","avg_batch_size"])
```
Julian Park: thanks. We should prefer graceful throttling and informative 429s with Retry-After so customer SDKs can backoff. Current admission control returns a generic 503 for some paths.
Maya Chen: agreed. Short-term we rolled the reserved_throttle policy to prioritize committed throughput for corp-a (higher SLA) and degrade corp-b to best-effort at 15:20 UTC. That reduced queue depth a bit.
Support-Bot: created ticket REDWOOD-789 for corp-b (assigned @Sophie). Notifying account team.
Sophie Alvarez: on it. I told corp-b their scheduled jobs likely impacted; offering credits if SLA violated.
Leo Gupta: long-term fixes: 1) prefer region fallback to dedicated-donor pools, 2) expose per-reserved-customer queue metrics, 3) change admission control to return 429+Retry-After and expose estimated wait.
Julian Park: +1. Also we should tweak autoscaler to try cross-AZ placement or request spot-like capacity if committed can't be provisioned. Current cloud API returns "InsufficientInstances" for AZ A.
Maya Chen: Ops workaround: for now we've enabled cross-region routing to dedicated-usw2-b (other AZ) and allowed preemptible spillover for low-prio non-committed jobs. That required a quick policy change at 15:35 UTC.
oncall-bot: [action] policy-change applied by Maya Chen at 2025-11-08T15:35:44Z: allow_spillover_preemptible=true
Leo Gupta: we should also add a circuit-breaker metric on per-customer alloc rate, so we can autoscale per-customer or apply backpressure earlier than pool-level saturation.
Sophie Alvarez: customer comms draft -> "We saw transient capacity constraints in US-WEST-2 dedicated pools; we've applied temporary traffic controls and are offering credits if your reserved SLA was affected. Working on permanent mitigation." Shall I send?
Maya Chen: yes please. Ping customer success and include the metrics snippet and Retry-After guidance.
Julian Park: created a follow-up engineering ticket ENGOPS-1122: "Add per-reserved-customer admission metrics + 429 retry header" — assigned to Leo. ETA 2 sprints.
Leo Gupta: noted. I'll start a design doc and include proposed admission-control response payload: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
Retry-After: 30
{
  "error": "capacity_throttle",
  "estimated_wait_seconds": 30,
  "pool": "dedicated-usw2-reserved"
}
```
Maya Chen: immediate action items: 1) Sophie's customer comms, 2) Julian verify autoscaler cross-AZ behavior, 3) Leo design doc for per-customer metrics & 429 headers.
Sophie Alvarez: sending comms now.
Julian Park: checking autoscaler logs and cloud provider error codes — will post findings in this thread.
Maya Chen: thanks all. I'll leave the temporary policy in place until we confirm pool stability (monitoring for 1hr). If anything else spikes, we'll open an incident page.
Support-Bot: incident notes saved to /incidents/2025-11-08-dedicated-usw2-throttle.md
Maya Chen: closing thread for now; will add postmortem if SLA credits or recurring pattern emerges. :white_check_mark:
